cast.name: Creator
cast.description: Indian woman in her mid-20s, dark hair in a low ponytail, lavender top; casual smartphone UGC indoors then outdoors. Natural, friendly female voice: skeptical and surprised at the open, then explaining, ending pleased and convinced.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple sunscreen? I thought it would make me look purple.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple sits opposite yellow on the colour wheel, so it helps cancel yellow dullness.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: The tint is made for Indian skin.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: It blends in completely, no white cast.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Before: dull. After: smooth, even-looking Instant Glow.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple tint, Instant Glow, zero white cast. Makes sense!
